premises.text: Local network issues, fragmented camera brands, and customer-heavy deployment make custom camera software expensive
premises.evidence_span: The camera industry is incredibly fragmented

premises.text: A hosted web API plus end-user connection tooling reduces complexity for developers writing camera software
premises.evidence_span: We try and reduce all of that complexity and expose to the software developer a beautiful, modern, hosted web API

premises.text: Software written to the API works with any internet-connected camera and is as easy to deploy as phone apps
premises.evidence_span: make it as easy to get software working on a camera as it is today to get it working on a phone

premises.text: Being a developer-first hosted API differentiates from hosted security products and local platforms
premises.evidence_span: The difference is with our company, our product is an API

premises.text: Solutions generate recurring revenue per camera
premises.evidence_span: generating a recurring fee on a per-camera basis

value.text: Better customer service and camera-based software without developers owning the hardware complexity
value.evidence_span: Their customer is getting a better service

secondary_value.evidence_span: unleash a whole new category of software development based around the live image
